label: DRT7 system
definition: A DRT system in which an organism possesses a genome-encoded DefenseFinder DRT7 subtype locus represented by the DRT7__DRT7 or DRT7__DRT7_small profiles.
observations: DRT7 branch under DRT system; distinct from the broader DRT system, the individual DRT7 reverse-transcriptase profile rows, unresolved DRT7 phage triggers, direct RT products, host breadth, partner features, and other DRT subtypes.
